correctness.rationale: Shortest-border length m has exact probability u_m(q)/q^(2m), because the shortest border must be unbordered and any unbordered matching prefix/suffix is automatically the shortest border. Iterating gives an exact truncated product-sum for every fixed number of peeled pairs. Monotone convergence yields geometric tail probabilities s_q^r; s_q<1 follows from an explicit uniform bound. Empty-center probabilities form a summable renewal sequence and therefore vanish. The mean follows from dominated convergence. The formal-series proof uses a triangular recursion for shortest-border probabilities and the identical recursion for normalized first-part composition series. A separate induction identifies those composition numbers with the defining stabilized reverse row of A274190, hence A274199.
